certificate.description: The Ciena SAOS 10 MACSec Series of Service Access and Aggregation platforms use MACSec for traffic encryption/decryption. The platforms provide routing/switching functionalities for various use cases including enterprise, mobility, and converged network architectures. With Ethernet, MPLS, IP, and SR capabilities, the product supports emerging networks.
